A '''gladiatorial tournament''' was held [[Standard year/Legends|annually]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Nal Hutta/Legends|Nal Hutta]] by an [[Unidentified Hutt (Riegenn Hetuu)|eccentric member]] of the [[Hutt/Legends|Hutt]] [[Species/Legends|species]]. However, for the tournament<ref name="Codex" /> around [[3743 BBY]],<ref name="Time">{{TOR_dates|1}} As the Codex entry for [[K'lor'slug/Legends|k'lor'slugs]] is acquired on [[Korriban/Legends|Korriban]], a starting [[Planet/Legends|planet]], and states that the incident with Hetuu occurred "a [[Standard century/Legends|century]] ago." As a result, a date of approximately [[3743 BBY]] can be derived using simple math.</ref> the Hutt hired the [[Hunting/Legends|hunter]] [[Riegenn Hetuu]] to acquire a live [[K'lor'slug/Legends|k'lor'slug]] [[Queen/Legends|queen]], a creature from the planet [[Korriban/Legends|Korriban]], for the tournament's gala celebration. When Hetuu arrived on Nal Hutta, both the Hutt and Hetuu were [[Death/Legends|eaten alive]] by around four hundred k'lor'slugs that the queen had [[Reproduction/Legends|spawned]] in Hetuu's cargo hold.<ref name="Codex" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Hutt's tournament was mentioned in the Codex entry for k'lor'slugs in ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'', a [[Star Wars video games|video game]] released by [[BioWare]] in [[2011]].<ref name="Codex" />
